status: Derived explicit families with complete analytic proofs in RESEARCH_REPORT.txt; no historical priority claim.

input_class.equation: scalar linear conduction with real symmetric positive-definite matrix coefficient
input_class.units: fixed common coefficient and inverse units
input_class.digital_promises: valid expanded rational dyadic L1 coefficient name, rational positive tau and M

objects.parameters: tau>0, M>exp(tau); T0 integer >=max(4,2tau); dyadic 0<R<=1/4 with exp(tau)+pi R^2(18/T0+1)<M; T>=T0
objects.coordinate: r=distance from (1/2,1/2), t=log(R/r), r0=R exp(-T0), r_T=R exp(-T)
objects.annulus_coefficient: K(t) e_r e_r^T + K(t)^-1 e_theta e_theta^T, K(t)=2t^2/[tau(t+log t)]
objects.coefficient_1: I outside r_T<r<r0 and the shared annular coefficient inside that annulus
objects.coefficient_2: same as coefficient_1 except 2I for r<r_T
objects.image_volume: v_T=pi R^2 exp(-2T0) (T0/T)^tau exp(tau*((log T+1)/T-(log T0+1)/T0))
objects.effective_2_bounds: (1-v_T/2)^-1 I <= (A_2)_* <= (1+v_T)I in the two-dimensional active block
refuted_claims: A uniform Holder modulus ||A_*-C_*|| <= C ||A-C||_1^a for any a>0 on the entire fixed moment class
A uniform logarithmic modulus with power alpha>tau on that class
A uniform o(log(1/eta)^-tau) modulus on that class
objects.scope: An exact lower bound for the coefficient-to-effective-response map on a stated class; not an unrestricted runtime lower bound and not a counterexample to continuity.
objects.upper_endpoint_status: The upper estimate O(log(1/eta)^-tau) is not proved or refuted here.

objects.output: effective energy at loading e1 (or full effective tensor)
objects.worst_case_error_lower: v_T/4; a sharper bound is v_T/[2(2-v_T)]
objects.access: Only the uncertain record; no additional query of the true coefficient.
objects.scope: All deterministic algorithms and worst-case expected error of randomized algorithms with this information, regardless of internal compute.
objects.not_implied: No lower bound for an algorithm supplied with which exact coefficient formula is true; no universal bit-runtime bound from an accuracy exponent alone.

objects.identical_passive_data: Effective tensor I and complete Dirichlet-to-Neumann operator on the cell, because f_T is identity near the boundary.
objects.same_intervention: Add I on the physical disk r<r_T, zero elsewhere.
objects.conclusion: Passive data plus the specified coordinate-labelled intervention do not uniquely determine post-intervention response.
objects.scope: Anisotropic scalar class; does not rule out additional structural information, active interventions, or a known full coefficient.

completed_positive_results.finite_representation: construct rational SPD dyadic B from a valid name with ||A-B||_1<=3eta, moment<=M+1 and explicit uniform bounds (2R)^-1 I<=B<=2R I
completed_positive_results.cost: All source calls, interval parameters, grid expansion, exact rational arithmetic and the predecessor's discovered certificate stopping stages are charged.
